components.name: 文字標籤

code: const b = env.box, u = clamp(t / p.inDur, 0, 1), s = ease.outBack(u), fade = clamp((env.duration - t) / 0.25, 0, 1);

if (p.side === 'above') { y = b.y - tail - h / 2; ty = b.y - 4; }
else if (p.side === 'below') { y = b.y + b.h + tail + h / 2; ty = b.y + b.h + 4; }
else if (p.side === 'left') { x = b.x - tail - w / 2; tx = b.x - 4; }
else { x = b.x + b.w + tail + w / 2; tx = b.x + b.w + 4; }
x = clamp(x, w / 2 + 8, env.width - w / 2 - 8); y = clamp(y, h / 2 + 8, env.height - h / 2 - 8);
const ax = tx - x, ay = ty - y, vertical = p.side === 'above' || p.side === 'below';
// 以尖角為中心彈出，再把原點移回標籤中心
g.save(); g.alpha(fade); g.translate(tx, ty); g.scale(s, s); g.translate(-ax, -ay);
g.begin(); g.roundRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h, h * 0.3); g.fill({color: p.color});
if (vertical) { const by = Math.sign(ay) * (h / 2 - 1); g.moveTo(-tail * 0.6, by); g.lineTo(ax, ay); g.lineTo(tail * 0.6, by); }
else { const bx = Math.sign(ax) * (w / 2 - 1); g.moveTo(bx, -tail * 0.6); g.lineTo(ax, ay); g.lineTo(bx, tail * 0.6); }

const b = env.box, cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;

// 鏡片裡是放大的下層畫面；沒有下層畫面時填半透明底色
if (bg.available) g.image(bg, cx - r / p.zoom, cy - r / p.zoom, 2 * r / p.zoom, 2 * r / p.zoom, cx - r, cy - r, 2 * r, 2 * r);

g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy + fy); g.scale(s, s); g.translate(-cx, -cy);
g.begin(); g.circle(cx, cy, r); g.stroke({color: p.color, width: p.width});
g.begin(); g.arc(cx, cy, r - p.width * 1.2, -2.4, -1.4); g.stroke({color: '#ffffff', width: p.width * 0.5, cap: 'round', alpha: 0.7});  // 反光
